description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSeacrest Lagoon Pool, Pet Friendly, 5 Bikes, Quick Walk to the Beach 'FantaSEA'The Space FantaSea – Spacious Seacrest Beach Retreat with Lagoon Pool & Beach Access! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Pet Friendly (1 Pet Allowed) – Bring your furry friend along for the fun! Access to 12,000 Sq. Ft. Seacrest Lagoon Pool – One of the largest resort pools on 30A! Seasonal Tram Service – Free transportation to & from the beach (March - October) 5 Adult Bikes Included – Easily explore Seacrest, Rosemary & Alys Beach Spacious Wraparound Balcony & Decks – Enjoy outdoor lounging & dining Outdoor Grill & Fully Equipped Kitchen – Perfect for home-cooked meals & BBQ nights Multiple Master Suites with Private Balconies – King beds, ensuite baths & ample space Dedicated Bunk Room for Kids – Fun & cozy with twin-over-twin bunks & TV entertainment Outdoor Shower – Rinse off after a beach day Walking Distance to Beach Access & Rosemary Beach – Prime location for dining, shopping & fun Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to FantaSEAWelcome to FantaSea, a charming vacation rental in Seacrest Beach that offers everything you need for a memorable getaway. This home is designed for relaxation, adventure, and family fun, with a spacious layout that comfortably accommodates up to 16 guests. Located just a short 11-minute walk or 4-minute bike ride to the beach and a 5-minute walk to the stunning Seacrest Lagoon Pool, this property is the perfect base for your Florida escape. The home is also only a 4-minute drive from Rosemary Beach, ensuring convenient access to local shops, dining, and activities.From the moment you arrive, you’ll feel the welcoming vibe of the Seacrest community. The pedestrian-friendly sidewalks and complimentary tram service make it easy to explore the area, whether by foot, bike, or a quick ride to the beach. The highlight of the community is the expansive 12,000-square-foot pool, perfect for cooling off and relaxing.FantaSea is a thoughtfully designed Florida cottage that blends comfort and style. The wraparound balcony with natural wood ceilings sets the tone for a serene stay. A playful tin bucket by the entrance welcomes your flip-flops as you enter the home using a keyless entry system.On the first floor, you’ll find an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area, ideal for gathering with family and friends. The kitchen features beautiful white quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and everything you need to prepare meals. A grill on the adjacent balcony expands your culinary options. The dining table and breakfast bar together provide seating for 14, and the cozy living room with a 50” flat-screen TV invites you to unwind. This level also includes a king master suite with an ensuite bathroom, comfortable bedding, a reach-in closet, and a 48” flat-screen TV.Upstairs, the second floor offers additional sleeping arrangements, including another king master suite with a private balcony and ensuite bathroom. A second suite combines a king bed with twin-over-twin bunk beds and its own private balcony. Kids will love their dedicated bunk room, featuring two twin-over-twin bunk beds, a standalone twin bed, and a pull-out twin trundle. This fun space also includes a walk-in closet and a 32” TV with channels like Disney and Nickelodeon. There is also a queen guest suite with cozy bedding, a 32” TV, and a reach-in closet. A central bathroom and laundry facilities complete the upper level. Every bedroom in this home is thoughtfully outfitted with tasteful decor, ample storage, and a welcoming ambiance, ensuring that all guests feel pampered and at ease during their stay.When you're ready to soak up the sun and enjoy some beachside relaxation, reaching the shoreline is effortless. A short stroll—just a block and a quick walk across 30A—or a ride on the complimentary seasonal tram will get you there in no time. For those seeking the perfect blend of world-class beaches and the vibrant local charm that 30A is known for, "FantaSEA" is the ultimate destination for your next unforgettable vacation.House Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**PET POLICY:- Max one pet under 35 pounds-$150 non-refundable Pet Fee and $500 Refundable Pet Deposit Required. Please contact our office after booking to add your pet to your reservation.-Guests will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.-Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (16)1st Floor Master Bedroom: King sized bed and private bathroom2nd Floor Master Bedroom: King sized bed and private bathroom2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: King sized bed, Twin over Twin bunk bed and private bathroom2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen sized bed2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: (2) Twin over twin bunks, Twin bed (Total of 5 twin beds)AREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**Show less
